title: How to Survive a Nuclear Blast
lines: If a nuclear bomb goes off near you, | you have about ten minutes to save your life. | Here's exactly what to do.
First, the flash. | Don't look: it can blind you. | Drop face down and cover your head.
Seconds later, the blast wave hits. | Stay down until it passes. | Then stay away from windows: flying glass kills.
Then get inside. | Brick or concrete, in the basement or the middle of the building. | Not your car: it barely protects you.
Because the fallout is coming: | radioactive dust, deadliest in the first hours.
After seven hours, it's ten times weaker. | After two days, a hundred times.
So stay inside for at least twenty-four hours. | Don't go looking for family: they should shelter where they are.
Would you know where to go? | Tell me in the comments.
